title: Remove implementation narration
why: Step-by-step narration duplicates control flow rather than explaining a constraint or design decision.
suggestion: Delete the narration or replace it with the non-obvious reason the implementation is necessary.
limitations: Only explicit first-person sequencing phrases are reported. Comment paragraphs explaining a condition, trade-off, causal outcome (including 'this allows/enables us to'), avoidance or failure constraint, safety contract, equation, specification, example, or external reference are excluded. Paragraphs may be separated by blank comment or whitespace-only lines, but executable statements and quoted statements stop rationale propagation.

Documentation comments, test sources, Rust raw and multiline strings, and JavaScript/TypeScript template text are excluded. Unlabelled algorithm or protocol sequencing can remain an intentional advisory review candidate; the detector does not prove commentary is redundant.
